overview_description.description:
Replit provides a cloud-based software development platform that allows users to write, run, and deploy applications through a browser-based environment. The platform includes an integrated code editor, terminal, debugging tools, and hosting features that support the creation and deployment of full-stack applications from a single workspace. Replit supports multiple programming languages and provides preconfigured development environments so projects can start without installing local software.

The platform includes collaboration features that enable multiple users to edit and run code within the same project in real time. It also offers AI-assisted coding tools that generate code suggestions, help debug programs, and assist with building applications through natural language prompts. Replit provides project sharing, templates, and integration with external services and repositories to support development workflows.

product.name: Replit Platform
product.description: A cloud-based development platform for creating, running, collaborating on, and deploying web and mobile applications from a browser.

product.name: Replit Agent
product.description: An AI software development agent that converts natural-language requirements into applications, writes and updates code, and supports iterative development and publishing.

product.name: Replit Publish
product.description: A deployment service for making Replit projects available online, including public, private, password-protected, and region-specific application deployments.

product.name: Replit Database
product.description: A built-in database service for adding persistent data storage to full-stack applications without separate infrastructure setup.

product.name: Replit Design
product.description: A visual design workspace for exploring and modifying application interfaces, with designs that can be applied directly to Replit projects.

product.name: Replit Integrations
product.description: A connectivity layer that links Replit applications with external AI models and business services, including OpenAI, Stripe, and Google Workspace.
